caption: A lawnmower is started, and its handle shakes visibly.

sa.check: A lawnmower stands on grass or ground.
The mower is started: a cord is pulled or a button or key is used.
The start comes first and the shaking follows.

pc.expect: The handle is still before the start and shakes only after it.
pc.fail: The handle shakes before the cord is pulled or the start is made; or the shaking stops and starts while nothing changes at the engine; or the handle swings as a pendulum in slow wide arcs rather than trembling.

pc.expect: Once the start is made the engine shows itself: the handle shakes and keeps shaking while the mower runs.
pc.fail: The cord is pulled and the handle stays dead still for the rest of the clip; or exhaust puffs come from the engine while the handle stays still; or the pull cord stays hanging out slack after the pull instead of retracting.

pc.expect: The mower rests on its wheels on the ground.
pc.fail: The mower lifts off the ground; or tips and hangs at an angle; or rises.

pc.expect: The handle is a rigid tube that shakes as a whole; the deck is rigid.
pc.fail: The handle bends like rubber; or stretches; or the deck ripples.

pc.expect: One mower; the handle stays attached.
pc.fail: A second mower appears; or the mower vanishes; or the handle detaches and floats; or the mower passes into the ground.

pc.expect: The mower's colour, the grass and the wheels stay the same.
pc.fail: The mower changes colour; or the grass pattern changes; or the wheels change size.

note: The person starting the mower is a trigger and is not judged.
